profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
❖ Enhance 4 customer-facing experiences for Chase.com across various lines of business, including investment funding and
wealth management from legacy proprietary JS frameworks to dynamic React-TypeScript(v18) applications, multiple times a year on a rolling basis. 

❖ Create and maintain 2 new customer-facing experiences for Chase.com and the hybrid mobile experience compliant with ADA guidelines for frontend accessibility in React-TypeScript(v18)

❖ Coordinate monthly to bi-monthly customer-facing production deployments, rolling out new features for our client facing applications, by creating and managing snow tickets, and leading CICD pipeline management by validating applications in QA environments & promoting applications to the production CDN to be consumed by CXO platform team

❖ Maintain 7 spring rest service applications and 5 consuming micro front end applications in React TypeScript for internal advisors ensuring optimal performance and functionality at all times by e�ciently rolling out new or enhanced features from Product, or promptly resolving bugs the advisors may encounter while using the applications.

❖ Collaborate bi-weekly with diverse cross-functional teams (devs, product managers and designers) to refine requirements for new and in progress projects, these refinements include desk checks with designers, conversations about the feasibility of tasks requested, optimizing and specifying analytic events, and troubleshootings development roadblocks that require input from product.

❖ Enhance legacy advisor facing applications by upgrading from react class component architecture to react functional component architecture, as well as upgrade redux and store implementations to react context and reducer implementations for managing local global state in an organized way.

❖ Reduce gaia server cost to firm by 30% by implementing light-switch to turn off pools during times of light load and automatically restart pools during times of heavy load
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Front-End Development · Jules · React.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description: Collaborated with team of 6 interns to plan, build, and present a web application for the non-profit organization Family Promise across 5 weeks. Built an online platform to host and track progress of prerequisite trainings for new volunteers. Met daily for virtual standups to create requirements using the Atlassian suite. Implemented front-end in React, created a SQL database to manage user data, and created REST services to update user data. Completed weekly coding challenges in Java and Python such as creating restful services or filtering through large datasets via Java collections.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · React.js · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Ported frontend algorithm in TypeScript to a Java backend service to create a consumable webservice. Updated old web application UI with dynamic components creating a more organized and scalable user experience.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Node.js

company.name: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Developed a web server and basic front end for the "Irregular Warfare Decision Assist for Determining Threat" project led by Dr. Charles Kim. Developed SQL queries to import and analyze data. Created functions in Python to calculate statistics within the database.

positions.title: Project Member, Scheduling Application
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · On-site
positions.description: Collaborated with a team of fellow students to develop a scheduling and prioritization system for college students. Implemented frontend using HTML and CSS. Implemented datastore with JavaScript to store and retrieve values in a google firebase database. Defined project roles and responsibilities including project scope and goals for each member. Team placed 4th of thirty-five teams.

positions.title: Google Computer Science Summer Institute Scholar
positions.description: Sharpened knowledge in multiple coding languages with Google engineers for across five-week period (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python).

positions.title: Home Appliance Sales Associate
positions.description: Provided proactive sale consultations and support to customers on the sales floor. Exceeded monthly department standards and sales goals. Performed sales-support activities as necessary such as follow up with members on consultations or tracking of orders and deliveries.

honors.issuer: Issued by Castro Valley Unified School District · Jan 2017
